title: Premium Payment Event
description: Proposed provider-independent payment event. No payer personal data, payment token, secret, or raw provider body is included.

eventId.description: Deterministic identity derived from provider and business-event identity.

paymentKey.description: Proposed stable payment-lifecycle key sized for Salesforce Payment_Key__c.

amount.description: Original amount in major currency units, normalized to two decimal places.

refundedAmount.description: Refunded amount in major currency units when supplied by the provider; otherwise null.

stateChangedAt.description: Provider state-change time normalized to UTC.

receivedAt.description: Time Meridian accepted the webhook, in UTC.

correlationId.description: Meridian-generated identifier for this HTTP delivery.
